header.author-notes:
Requirements: php ver. 5 or later
Installation:
1. Register on our site (https://www.keycaptcha.com/accounts/reguser). 2. Activate your account by clicking the activation link, which is sent to the e-mail you specified during registration. 3. Log in to our site. 4. At the page "My Sites" add information about your site, which you plan to protect with KeyCAPTCHA. 5. Choose "Installation Instructions" in the right menu "Free Account" 6. Follow the instalation instructions on the opened page.
After installation, please, check all forms that you protected by KeyCAPTCHA. If you have any questions feel free to contact our Support Team (https://www.keycaptcha.com/tickets/list/0/). Our experts help you to install KeyCAPTCHA on your site for free.
